name: Registrar Ostra
description: A brisk young woman with ink-stained fingers and a ledger the size of a door. The System appointed her Gate Registrar for the village district, and she has not slept properly since.

root.npc_text: 'Another adventurer! Good. The rifts don't close themselves.' Ostra flips her ledger open. 'Bounties, rumours, or both?'

options.label: What do you know about the Gates?
options.npc_response: 'They open, someone moves in, someone kills them, someone else moves in. Check the Registry: it lists who rules each one this week.'

options.label: Farewell.

name: Sister Ilse
description: A grey-robed healer with a herb satchel and the calm of someone who has seen every kind of wound.

root.npc_text: 'Sit, if you're hurt. Stand, if you're here to help.' Sister Ilse smiles. 'I always need help.'

name: Old Brannoc
description: A retired monster-hunter with one eye, a pipe, and a bow he still keeps oiled.

root.npc_text: Brannoc squints at you with his good eye. 'You've got the look. Hunting, is it? Sit down. I'll teach you something.'

description: A halfling engineer in a leather apron full of tools, most of which he invented.

root.npc_text: 'Careful, don't touch that, it's live.' Odo wipes his hands. 'Looking for work? I always need parts.'

description: A road-warden in a green cloak, bow across her back, who knows every path between the camp and the hills.

root.npc_text: 'Roads are worse every week,' says Sorrel. 'Rifts everywhere. Want to do something about it?'

name: Petra the Cartographer
description: An explorer with a dozen rolled maps under one arm and a compass that she taps constantly.

root.npc_text: 'Half of my maps are wrong now,' Petra sighs. 'The rifts keep moving things. I need eyes inside them.'

name: Magister Aldane
description: A Spire scholar in robes covered in chalk formulae, who speaks very fast and listens very carefully.

root.npc_text: 'Ah! A practitioner. Or a potential one.' Aldane peers at you. 'The rifts are the greatest arcane laboratory in history. Let me show you.'

root.npc_text: 'If you're here to complain, join the queue,' says Captain Venn. 'If you're here to fight, I have work.'

root.npc_text: 'Records,' says Tolven, 'are the only thing the Fracture couldn't break. Mostly. Help me keep them.'

root.npc_text: 'Bring me rift metal,' Halvard rumbles, 'and I'll make you something the System will have to invent a new rarity for.'

root.npc_text: 'You look capable,' says Lady Vos, 'and expendable. I mean that kindly. I collect things, and I pay well for them.'

root.npc_text: 'The dead have been restless since the Fracture,' says Cassian. 'They need someone to remind them how to rest.'

root.npc_text: 'You want to fight better?' Mabb grins. 'Good. Then you're going to hurt more first.'
